---
name: Bluetooth Alert beta test
about: Report a generated-alert test on one phone and Bluetooth receiver
title: '[Beta test] '
---

Email is the preferred way to report (see the tester page). If you use GitHub instead: please test while stationary and use generated app alerts or a dummy notification you created. One phone/receiver combination per report. Write **Unknown** or **Not tested** where appropriate; setup failures are useful too.

**This issue is public.** Use generic product models, not personalized Bluetooth names. Do not include notification text, personal details, locations, license plates, VINs, serial numbers, IMEI, MAC/Bluetooth addresses, debug logs, app exports, screenshots or ZIP files here; send those only by email, after removing personal information.

- App version (shown near the top of the app, or on the release page):
- Android phone make/model:
- Android version:
- Receiver type (car / boat / motorcycle or bike / stereo / speaker / headset / other):
- Receiver make/model and year, if known:
- Installation (success / failed / update or signature conflict / not tested):
- Bluetooth music connection (connected / pairing failed / paired but music connection failed / receiver missing / permission blocked / not tested):
- Generated title on receiver (whole title / cut short / wrong characters / delayed / did not appear / still waiting / no display / button disabled / not tested):
- Play (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Pause (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Next (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Previous (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Disconnect/reconnect (test worked again / connected but title missing / could not reconnect / app needed reopening / not tested):
- Music after dismissing alert (automatic resume / manual restart needed / no resume / kept switching / not tested):
- Notification access (left off / enabled for recovery tests / blocked or unavailable / unknown):
- Receiver off under 30 min (same alert resumed with title and audio / title only / audio only / did not resume / duplicate or stuck / not tested):
- Three quick power flaps (reconnected each time / missed a reconnect / duplicate or stuck / not tested):
- Out of range and back (same options as receiver off):
- Force-stop and reopen (same options as receiver off):
- Away over 30 min (only Welcome back with a count / old alert replayed / nothing shown / notification text shown / not tested):
- Away over 30 min with app killed or phone restarted (same options):
- "Delivering an alert" notification (appeared then went away / stayed / did not appear / Android older than 8 / not tested):

- [ ] I checked that this report contains no personal information or uniquely identifying device information.

These are my observations on a physical receiver, not a protocol capture or proof of every capability.
